intro.text: Hallandren's god of nature, one of the gods who play Tarachin every week with Lightsong, Weatherlove and Lifeblesser.

items.text: For Truthcall the weekly game is really a chance to scheme. Among his duties is voting on foreign trade, and he thinks little of Idris; he plans to pressure Siri into giving Hallandren better access to the trade routes between the two kingdoms, though as a manipulator he is no match for Blushweaver.

appearance.text: Almost seven feet tall, muscular and square-jawed, with black hair. He likes military-style uniforms in his colours, maroon and silver.
